# Let me check the left strip more carefully across different player positions
# First, let me record the left strip at current position (player UP at 30-35)
seg = current_frame.segmentation

def get_left_strip(seg):
    """Get left strip segments sorted by row"""
    strips = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('g', 'G') and n['pixels'] <= 8:
            b = n['boundary']
            r_min = min(p[0] for p in b)
            r_max = max(p[0] for p in b)
            c_min = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if c_min == 13:
                strips.append((r_min, r_max, n['color'], n['pixels']))
    strips.sort()
    return strips

print("Current left strip (player at 30-35):")
for s in get_left_strip(seg):
    print(f"  {s[2]}: {s[0]}-{s[1]} ({s[3]} px)")

# Now let me go DOWN and check
action(['DOWN'])
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation

for s in get_left_strip(seg2):
    print(f"  {s[2]}: {s[0]}-{s[1]} ({s[3]} px)")

# Go back UP
action(['UP'])
seg3 = current_frame.segmentation
